### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[P]: When detailing treatment plans, only include the medication, dosage, frequency, and duration explicitly stated by the provider. Do not infer or add the purpose or mechanism of action unless directly mentioned in the transcript.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Avoid using specific diagnostic labels (e.g., "acute respiratory distress") or definitive causal statements (e.g., "likely related to") unless explicitly stated by the provider. Focus on observed symptoms and stated plans for evaluation.
